item.title: A private Strava setup journey
item.summary: Starting or repairing Strava now uses one durable Connect journey instead of asking you to copy developer credentials into Murph.
item.details: Murph creates or recovers only its marked private application, seals credentials without displaying them, continues with read-only OAuth, and keeps saved progress for sign-in, consent, retry, disconnect, and deletion. This release records checked-in workflow and deterministic fake-provider validation; it does not claim external production launch proof.
